newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended March 19 rose to $974.48 billion from a revised $971.87 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 665 retail money market mutual funds rose $2.44 billion to $646.31 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds rose $2.58 billion to $526.81 billion, while assets of the 263 tax-exempt funds fell $137.2 million to $119.50 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 323 institutional money market funds rose $166.9 million to $328.17 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds increased $664.8 million to $294.87 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $497.9 million to $33.31 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $971.87 billion from $970.84 billion.
